item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Nearly 200 displaced after Wesley Chapel apartment fire; community rallies with donations
item.description: In just two days, nearly 200 residents of the Cobalt Apartments have lost everything after a lightning strike sparked a massive fire that destroyed their homes.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Pasco County mother and son housed after Cobalt Apartment fire
item.description: A Pasco County mother and son are housed again after losing everything to the Cobalt Apartment fire on Thursday afternoon.
